title: SK Hynix CEO says Indiana will be key memory production base by 2030, first U.S. facility now underway
summary_full: At the groundbreaking ceremony for SK Hynix's first U.S. facility, CEO Kwak Noh-Jung says Indiana will be a key memory production base by 2030.
